subject: Request for traditional peacock wick placement instructions
message: Hello Divine Brass team, how should the 5 oil wicks be placed in the peacock tail reservoir?

conversation.message: Hello Divine Brass team, how should the 5 oil wicks be placed in the peacock tail reservoir?
Namaste Priya! Gently fan the 5 cotton wicks outward along the scalloped edge of the peacock tail. Pour pure sesame or mustard oil up to 3/4 level. It burns steadily for over 6 hours!
